items.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Doris Day is made by the interviewer as part of a list of popular songs.

ctx.x: Because I’ve been reading about you and I say oh, I wanted to be in the booth for that and you could just think of so many moments. I’d like to put — imagine you at age oh somewhere between age 13 and 14 and I was looking at the pop songs, the top popular songs of those years. And I see things like Doris Day “Sentimental Journey” and Perry Como “Prisoner of Love.” And if we kept going we’d arrive at “Rock Around the Clock” and Elvis Presley. So my question, what was it in popular music being played on the radio…
Oh are you talking about records that I’ve heard that I wanted to —
